name: smwsprites-cheep-cheep-that-moves-like-a-dolphin
title: Cheep-Cheep that moves like a dolphin
description:
A cheep-cheep that follows a pattern similar to an original game dolphin. The extra bit will set the pattern it follows. Requires sprite buoyancy to be enabled.
Requested by Blind Devil.
